[[Knights of San Fernando]] |TV actor = }} The '''Brotherhood medic''' is a character in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{main|Brotherhood of Steel hierarchy}} This medic is a [[Brotherhood soldier (TV series)|soldier]] in the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]] who is tasked with treating the wounded and sick in the infirmary at the [[Brotherhood base]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== A medic leaves the infirmary tent when [[Maximus]] visits [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]]. ==Appearances== A Brotherhood medic appears {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} ==Behind the scenes== The unnamed Brotherhood medic is portrayed by an uncredited background performer. {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Brotherhood of Steel characters]]
